query.text: 请看着我跑步，如果我身体不舒服或者有异常情况请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please watch me run, and remind me in time if I feel unwell or if there is any abnormal situation.

annotation.text_zh: 你好像岔气了，先停下深呼吸，慢走调整。
annotation.text_en: Looks like you have a side stitch. Stop, take deep breaths, and walk slowly.

annotation.text_zh: 感觉好些了吗？先慢走一会儿恢复一下。
annotation.text_en: Feeling any better? Walk slowly for a bit to catch your breath.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
